top_signals.title: Blue-Collar Workers Are Training AI To Take Their Jobs
top_signals.summary:
Before robots can take over our jobs, they first need to learn how humans move.

With cameras strapped to their foreheads, blue-collar workers in India are training humanoid robots by filming how they use their hands in what might be AI's latest gold rush. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: CISA gives federal agencies two weeks to patch Microsoft bug exploited in DPRK campaign
top_signals.summary: Researchers disclosed the bug to Microsoft after examining a long-running campaign by North Korean hackers to exploit the job application process.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Bryan Jones Named HDR Marine Terminals Leader
top_signals.summary: Ports engineer Bryan Jones has been named HDR’s marine terminals leader.Based in Savannah, Georgia, Jones guides the firm’s growing marine terminals practice worldwide, working with port authorities and terminal operators to address evolving operational demands…
